# Krizaka

> Krizaka is a Montréal (Québec) software studio building open-source,
> production-ready platforms where compliance, security and modularity are
> enforced in code. Two products, every repository public under Apache-2.0
> at https://github.com/krizaka.

## Products

- Orazaka — sovereign, on-premise AI orchestration engine (chat, RAG, agents,
  image, audio, video) on a hexagonal architecture (Java 21, Spring Boot 4,
  Spring AI 2) enforced by ArchUnit. Law 25 / GDPR compliant by design: data
  never leaves your network. Split into one repository per component so other
  applications reuse users, notifications, billing, the edge and the UI kit.
- Orochia — open-source video platform for independent creators (adult-friendly,
  18+): direct-to-CDN streaming with 5-minute signed URLs, server-side access
  control, gateway-confirmed payments settled exactly once, double-entry ledger,
  18 U.S.C. § 2257 creator verification and persisted content reports.
